meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 这个 Python 库帮你把已有的 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到超出内存的数据或跨机器集群上,可读写多文件、并行计算、产出 DataFrame/Array/Bag 与分布式任务。
howto.when: 当数据超过可用内存、要把 pandas/NumPy 操作扩展到更大数据集,或需要并行处理多个文件、构建自定义并行任务时,会用它接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Dask (a Python library) to scale your existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters, reading many files, computing in parallel, and producing DataFrames, Arrays, Bags and distributed tasks.
howto.when_en: Use it when data exceeds available RAM, when pandas/NumPy work must scale to larger datasets, or when parallel multi-file processing and custom parallel workflows are needed.
